label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.48 a.2…: There is EVIL_1 in some being
locator: I q.48 a.2 co.: manifestum est quod in rebus malum invenitur
interpretation: The article's conclusion, which Aquinas draws from the deficiency of things that can fail from good together with 'in hoc consistit ratio mali, ut aliquid deficiat a bono'. Only existence is formalized. The witness spells 'malum' with OCR residue ('malunr'').
